title: Algerian Perilla Tagine
description: A hearty and savory North African stew made with perilla leaves, a staple ingredient in Algerian cuisine. This tagine is comforting and flavorful.

ingredients.name: Hearty vegetables (such as carrots, zucchini, bell peppers)

instructions: In a large saucepan, heat the olive oil over medium heat.
Add the garlic and cook for 1-2 minutes until fragrant.
Add the mixed vegetables, perilla leaves, olives, and tagine spice blend.
Stir to combine and cook for 2-3 minutes.
Add the salt, black pepper, and lemon juice.
Stir to combine and cook for an additional 2-3 minutes.
Reduce heat to low and simmer, covered, for 10-15 minutes or until the vegetables are tender.
